sources.title: 光本位联合文心快码打造面向光电芯片研发的全栈 AI Agent Lightmate
sources.evidence: The August 11, 2026 article identifies Cobuddy as Baidu's code-generation model integrated into Lightmate. The complete HTML was fetched directly after a web-reader timeout; embedded article metadata names 文心快码Baidu_Comate as author. It supplies no model parameter counts, architecture, license, or original release date.

sources.title: CoBuddy API & Playground
sources.evidence: The exact baidu/cobuddy offering is named CoBuddy and attributed to Baidu. Supported Functionality lists context 128K, output 64K, function calling supported, reasoning supported, and text input/output. It documents a hosted API, not whether the developer distributes weights.

sources.title: CoBuddy on Novita AI: Coding LLM API for Code Generation and Agents
sources.evidence: The provider's June 9, 2026 article names exact ID baidu/cobuddy and gives 131,072 tokens as its context size. It describes a Baidu code-generation model offered for coding and agent workflows. Its date concerns Novita availability and does not establish initial developer release.

sources.title: Baidu Qianfan: CoBuddy
sources.evidence: Indexed first-party provider text lists CoBuddy and May 6, 2026 as its release date, with 131,072-token context. The live web-reader body returned navigation rather than model details. The provider listing does not establish whether May 6 was the developer's earliest public release.

sources.title: Hugging Face model search for cobuddy
sources.evidence: The public model-search API returned an empty array at audit time. This search did not locate a checkpoint or model card, but absence from this hub does not establish closed weights.

sources.title: ERNIE 5.0 Technical Report
sources.evidence: The complete HTML technical report was searched for Cobuddy with no match. Its ERNIE 5.0 architecture, parameter statements and elastic submodels do not identify Cobuddy or establish its lineage or structural equivalence.

sources.title: ERNIE 5.1 Officially Released!
sources.evidence: The May 9, 2026 first-party technical announcement was checked for Cobuddy and contained no occurrence. ERNIE 5.1 parameter compression and architecture statements cannot be transferred to this differently named model.

sources.title: ERNIE for Developers post mentioning Cobuddy availability
sources.evidence: The original post returned HTTP 403. A third-party profile mirror supplied a discovery lead mentioning OpenRouter availability; that mirror is not used to verify an original release date.

sources.title: Baidu ERNIE public post, May9,2026
sources.publisher: Baidu ERNIE for Developers / X syndication
sources.evidence: Parent retrieved the public first-party post dated2026-05-09T04:53:58Z. Baidu says it has launched Cobuddy and that it is currently available on OpenRouter, linking the exact baidu/cobuddy:free listing. This corroborates early-May public availability but does not independently establish May6 as an original developer launch date.

name.note: Baidu uses Cobuddy in prose; the exact hosted model ID is displayed as CoBuddy.

developer.note: Both the developer article and the exact provider page attribute the model to Baidu.

family.note: No accessed developer source assigns Cobuddy to a model family. Qianfan is a platform/branding label; no ERNIE family membership or checkpoint lineage is assumed.

release_date.note: Earliest documented public availability in the accessed evidence: OpenRouter explicitly labels this exact model released May6,2026. Baidu confirms the model has launched and is available on that exact OpenRouter endpoint in a May9 first-party post. Retain the provider-documented release date with this provenance; the original developer announcement date remains unresolved and the later May9/June9 reports are not substituted for it.

open_weights.note: No exact weight distribution or explicit developer statement of non-distribution was located. A hosted API and an empty Hugging Face search do not prove closed weights; clear the baseline false assertion.

license.note: No exact-model license or supported proprietary distribution classification was verified. Service availability is insufficient to infer a weight license.

parameters_b.note: The accessed developer/product sources do not state total parameters. Exact-name searches of developer sites, Hugging Face, GitHub and papers located no model card/config; checked ERNIE research contains no Cobuddy-labeled count. Third-party estimates are not adopted.

active_parameters_b.note: No exact-model active-parameter disclosure or activation definition was found. Neither sibling ERNIE counts nor a dense total-equals-active convention is applied.

architecture.note: No accessed exact-model source identifies dense/MoE structure or Transformer configuration. ERNIE technical disclosures and third-party architecture estimates do not establish Cobuddy architecture.

context_window.note: Novita explicitly reports 131,072 tokens for baidu/cobuddy; its model page rounds this to 128K. This is the documented served context limit.

modalities.note: The exact provider model page lists text input and text output.

reasoning.note: The exact provider model page explicitly marks Reasoning supported; this is documented API capability, not a benchmark claim.

tool_call.note: The exact provider model page explicitly marks Function Calling supported.

sources.label: Novita exact model and context documentation
Baidu confirms CoBuddy launch and OpenRouter availability

patch.notes: Baidu confirms Cobuddy as a code-generation model; Novita documents its served context and capabilities. Total/active parameters and architecture remain undisclosed in accessed exact-model sources. Weight distribution, license and family remain unverified. May6,2026 is the earliest documented public release in the accessed evidence, explicitly reported by OpenRouter and corroborated by Baidu confirming availability there on May9; the original developer announcement date remains unresolved. No ERNIE sibling specifications are inherited.

summary: Verified identity and coding purpose using developer evidence, and served capabilities using exact provider documentation. Parent recovered a dated Baidu launch-confirmation post and retained May6 as the provider-documented public release, with original developer announcement date unresolved. Cleared unsupported closed-weight status. Total/active parameters and architecture remain undisclosed; family, license and weight distribution unresolved.
